Subject: Open-Book: Commit Guidance & Pocket Playbook

Team —

Quick note to kick off a lightweight field refresh on how we label Commit vs Best Case vs Pipeline. Differences are small but showing up in our Forecast against ACV, and Finance flagged a handful of deals where Commit tags didn't match the sales motion.

Attached: a one-page "pocket playbook" (pocket-playbook.odt) and the longer guidance (commit_guidance_v1.pdf). TL;DR:
- Commit = signed PO/contract OR written verbal confirmation + procurement milestone date AND clear spend owner.
- Best Case = strong signal (product eval + exec sponsor) but no procurement milestone.
- Pipeline = earlier interest or exploration.

Please do the following before Friday EOD:
1) Read the one-pager (5 minutes).
2) Run a quick filter in HubSpot for your top 20 open opportunities and flag any that you think are mis-categorized. Share 1-2 examples in the shared doc.
3) Join a 20-minute clinic on Thursday — I'll record and drop notes for anyone who can't make it.

Why this matters: Finance needs consistent commit tagging to forecast billing recognition and to size reserve capacity for Dedicated customers. Small fix = big delta on month's close.

Next steps: I own the playbook edits; Aditya, Vivek - can you each own a set of 10 opps for a first pass? Marissa, please coordinate invites & calendar.

Attachments: [Attachment: commit_guidance_v1.pdf (PDF, 180KB)], [Attachment: pocket-playbook.odt (ODT, 24KB)]

Thanks — Mina

Aditya —

Good questions. Answers below so you can proceed:
1) Renewals: If the customer has explicitly committed to renew verbally and there's a billing date within 30 days, mark as Commit and add a HubSpot note with the rep's summary and expected invoice date. Finance prefers a short note > no sticky internal email chains. If it's >30 days or only "likely", leave as Best Case.

2) Multi-product deals: Tag the opportunity at the line-item level in HubSpot if you have the capability (preferred). If you can't split line items, use the conservative approach: tag the entire opp as Best Case until the infra (Dedicated/private) PO is confirmed. Add a comment referencing the expected split.

I've created a short checklist in the Drive doc with examples: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cCommitGuide

Clinic: Thu 09/03 10:00-10:20 PT — calendar invite sent. Recording will be posted. Please add 1-2 HubSpot links under the "Examples" tab before the clinic.

I'll consolidate edits after the clinic and push v1.1 of the pocket playbook.

--
Mina
